personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Adapted with high-utility structural elements for sports scoring)
personality_one_liner: A crisp, authoritative, and fast-paced sports command center that balances legible data density with a clean, stadium-ready aesthetic.

spacing.rule: Generous outer padding (lg/xl) with tight coupling inside cards (xs/sm). Use distinct horizontal dividers for lists instead of heavy card shadows.

do's: Use glass effect on sticky headers over scrolling match feeds
Apply to the bottom tab bar to let match content scroll behind elegantly
Use over hero stadium imagery for featured tournaments
dont's: Never apply glass to the live scoreboard block—it needs maximum contrast and clarity
Do not use on data-heavy tables like the points table

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Onboard users with Phone OTP and Google login (mocked).

states.error: Inline text below input for invalid OTP.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of a stadium or cricket pitch at the top (with gradient scrim). Large clean title (Space Grotesk). Large, easy-to-tap inputs and a sticky primary CTA for OTP verification. Secondary button for Google Auth.

screens.name: Profile Setup
screens.layout: Form view. Use segmented controls/pills for 'Batting Style' (Right/Left Hand) and 'Bowling Style' (Pacer/Spinner/Medium). Large round avatar picker component. Sticky 'Save Profile' button at bottom.

screens.name: Home / Match Feed
screens.purpose: Discover live, upcoming, and completed matches and tournaments.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty stadium with CTA 'Create a Match'.
states.error: Failed to load feed with 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Horizontal scrolling list of 'Live Match' cards at the top. Vertical list of recent matches below. Match cards use a 2-column layout (Team A vs Team B) with team logos and prominent scores. Use 'brandPrimary' for Live indicators.

screens.name: Live Match Scoring (Command Center)
screens.purpose: Allow scorers to input ball-by-ball events and viewers to track stats.
screens.layout: Top half: Fixed scoreboard (surfaceInverse or brand) displaying Runs/Wickets, Overs, and CRR in huge Space Grotesk font. Middle: Current batter and bowler stats in a clean table layout. Bottom: A sticky control panel (bottom sheet) for the scorer with large pill buttons for Runs (0, 1, 2, 4, 6), Wicket, Extras (WD, NB).

screens.name: Tournament Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage tournament details, view matches, and check the points table.
screens.layout: Hero banner with tournament trophy image and title. Sticky segmented control (Matches | Teams | Points Table) below. Points Table tab: a data grid showing Team, P, W, L, Pts, and NRR. High contrast, mono-spaced numbers for stats. Highlight top 4 teams with subtle surfaceSecondary background.

screens.name: Profile / Stats
screens.purpose: View user's personal cricket career stats and teams.
screens.layout: Profile banner with user avatar overlapping a generic stadium background. Name and Role (e.g., 'Right Hand Bat • Off Spinner') in tags. Grid of key stats: Matches, Runs, Strike Rate, Wickets, Economy. Section below for 'My Teams'.

hero_tournament.alt: Cricket tournament trophy on a green field

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Blue/white clean sporty theme' requested by the user, utilizing the provided brandPrimary (#2563EB) and pristine white surfaces.
Implement the 'Space Grotesk' font for all numeric readouts, particularly the live scoreboard, over trackers, and points table. This is critical for the 'sports command center' feel.

For the 'Live Match Scoring' screen, build a persistent, fixed top section for the overall score, and use a bottom sheet or a fixed grid at the bottom for scorer inputs (runs, wickets, extras) so the scorer doesn't have to scroll to update the match.
In the Tournament Dashboard, the Points Table must be a horizontally scrollable or neatly packed grid showing Team, P, W, L, Pts, and NRR. Use fixed widths for columns to ensure alignment.
For Profile setup, use custom selectable pills (styled with brandTertiary and brand border when active) for 'Batting Style' and 'Bowling Style' instead of standard dropdowns.
Authentication flow should be mocked (UI only) but should feel native, using the hero_stadium image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at the top.
Images placed as card covers or headers MUST utilize the gradient scrim strategy specified in the <Imagery_and_Texture> rules for optimal text legibility.
All interactive elements (Scoring buttons, Tab swaps, Team additions) should include haptic feedback.
